Today is one session and one thing the app has noticed. There is never more than one thing to do on this screen.
The card at the top is today\'s session. It says what it is and roughly how long it takes.
The line under it is something the app noticed in your own records. It is never a warning and never asks you to do anything.
Nothing here counts days in a row or gives you a number for how you are doing overall.
What if I don\'t do one for a while?
Nothing happens. The next session starts from what you last did, not from the days in between, and it will be a little shorter for a few days until you are back into it.
Can I do more than one in a day?
Yes. When you finish, the card offers another one. The app will not ask you to.
Where does the noticed line come from?
From what you have put into this app, on this phone. Nothing is sent anywhere and nothing else is read.
This is a session. It reads itself out, so you can put the phone down and listen rather than watch.
The big number is how many you have done. The number under it is what the app is aiming for, which is a suggestion and not a rule.
The ring fills as you go. It is there so you can see where you are from across the room.
The four small buttons are always there: make it easier, skip this one, that\'s enough for today, and something hurts.
What if I stop early?
Press "That\'s enough for today". Everything you did is saved and it counts as a session.
What happens if I press "Something hurts"?
The session stops straight away and asks where. Whatever you pick is left out for the next week, without you having to do anything else.
Does it count for me?
For some movements, yes, if the phone is on you. For everything else, tap the ring once each time. Either way you can correct the number afterwards.
Everything you can do, and everything you have done. Sessions, walks, and the movements the app knows.
The top of the screen is what is available now.
Below it is what you have already done, most recent first.
Can I pick my own movement?
Yes. Open any movement and start it on its own. It is saved like any other session.
Why is something not on the list?
Either you left it out in Settings, or you said an area hurt in the last week. Both come back on their own.
What has changed since you started, in your own words and in numbers you can check.
Each row is one thing your body does, with where it is now.
Same is shown the same way as better, because staying where you are takes doing.
Why is nothing here yet?
It needs a few sessions before it can say anything honest. Until then it says nothing rather than guessing.
Can I add my own?
Yes. Anything you say you want to be able to do is kept in your words and tracked as its own row.
Your list, your settings, and how the app works. Everything here can be changed and nothing here is sent anywhere.
How you get around changes which movements are offered.
What to leave out hides anything you avoid, straight away.
Where is my information kept?
On this phone, encrypted, and nowhere else. There is no account and nothing to sign in to.
How do I get rid of it all?
Your data, then delete everything. It is immediate and there is no copy anywhere else.
